wire.hub_pull.ask.local_edits.note: Footnote under the preview lists. The leading '*' marks list entries that carry the user's own local edits; keep the '*' as the first character. Reassures that pulling never overwrites those edits.

wire.hub_pull.ask.more.note: Ends a capped list. {names} is an already-joined, comma-separated list of item labels such as 'skill research (3→4)'; {count} is how many more items were left out (always 1 or more).

wire.hub_pull.ask.new.note: Preview line: items shared by the organization that are not on this machine yet. {names} is a list of 'kind name' labels; kind words (agent, skill, team) are identifiers and stay English.

wire.hub_pull.ask.option.not_now.note: Decline option on the hub update ask. Choosing it changes nothing.

wire.hub_pull.ask.option.not_now.descrip.note: One line under the decline option.

wire.hub_pull.ask.option.update.note: Recommended option: approves pulling new organization items and updating already-pulled ones.

wire.hub_pull.ask.option.update.descript.note: One line under the approve option. 'the ones you already have' = items pulled earlier that have newer versions on the hub.

wire.hub_pull.ask.resubscribe.note: Preview line: items the user had stopped receiving updates for; approving makes them receive the organization's updates again. {names} as in ask.new.

wire.hub_pull.ask.title.note: First line of the ask, shown alone where the card has one row. {org} is the organization's display name. 'items' = agents, teams and skills the organization shares through its private Agent Hub.

wire.hub_pull.ask.updates.note: Preview line: items already on this machine with a newer version on the hub. {names} lists 'kind name (old→new)' labels; the revisions are opaque identifiers.
